Question
========
What is the main purpose of the data lifecycle model?

Answerlist
----------
* To reduce data-related bureaucracy
* To manage data storage devices
* To provide a framework for managing data efficiently
* To replace data analysis software


Solution
========
The main purpose of the data lifecycle model is to provide a framework for managing data from creation to long-term preservation.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* False
* True
* False
